cause.failure: Both Linux WebKit tests stop inside the plain native clone before Fountain typing. PRE owns focus and code caret, but End followed by typing inserts no text.

controls.editingSource: Separate reset to the same DOM/styles with only PRE tabindex removed; must focus the editor, retain a caret in code and insert exactly literal edited without changing After.
controls.rawException: Only Linux WebKit, only focused code region with a code caret and unchanged literal text. Other platforms/engines or text mutations still fail.
controls.fountain: Match the unchanged native focus when native editing works; otherwise match the independently working native source control. Require exact typing, code caret, no invented list paragraph, and undo restoring literal.
controls.label: Existing explicit editor-focus handoff, typing and undo assertions unchanged.
controls.accessibility: No renderer change; PRE remains a keyboard-focusable scrolling region in Fountain. Existing keyboard region tests stay in the full matrix.
